<parameter name="content">from enum import Enum


class State(Enum):
    CREATED = "created"
    PAID = "paid"
    SHIPPED = "shipped"
    DELIVERED = "delivered"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    REFUNDED = "refunded"


S = State
TRANSITIONS = {
    S.CREATED: {S.PAID, S.CANCELLED},
    S.PAID: {S.SHIPPED, S.REFUNDED},
    S.SHIPPED: {S.DELIVERED},
    S.DELIVERED: {S.REFUNDED},
    S.CANCELLED: set(),
    S.REFUNDED: set(),
}


class InvalidTransition(Exception):
    pass


class Order:
    def __init__(self, state: State = S.CREATED):
        self.state = state

    def can_transition(self, to: State) -> bool:
        return to in TRANSITIONS[self.state]

    def transition(self, to: State) -> None:
        if not isinstance(to, State):
            raise TypeError(f"expected State, got {type(to).__name__}")
        if not self.can_transition(to):
            raise InvalidTransition(f"{self.state.value} -> {to.value}")
        self.state = to


if __name__ == "__main__":
    o = Order()
    for s in (S.PAID, S.SHIPPED, S.DELIVERED, S.REFUNDED):
        o.transition(s)
    assert o.state is S.REFUNDED

    for start, bad in ((S.CREATED, S.SHIPPED), (S.SHIPPED, S.CANCELLED),
                       (S.CANCELLED, S.PAID), (S.REFUNDED, S.CREATED)):
        try:
            Order(start).transition(bad)
        except InvalidTransition:
            continue
        raise AssertionError(f"{start} -> {bad} should fail")
    print("ok")
